name: Links Awakening
description: Native PS5 homebrew port of Link's Awakening with 1080p rendering and 4K FSR1-upscaled output, DualSense controls, PlayStation button prompts, native audio and movie playback, a controller-operated launcher, touchpad settings menu, background shader compilation and persistent shader caches. Requires game files prepared from your own Switch version 1.0.0 base-game dump; game dumps, keys, generated game code and saves are not included.
author: mshivam019
